WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),ACCR_PENAL_DMD_OS)),0) ACCR_PENAL_DMD_OS_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),BCHG_DMD_OS)),0) BCHG_DMD_OS_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUM_CAPITALIZE_FEES)),0) CUM_CAPITALIZE_FEES_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),EMICAP_DEFERRED_INT)),0) EMICAP_DEFERRED_INT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),FIXED_PYMT)),0) FIXED_PYMT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),INT_DMD_OS)),0) INT_DMD_OS_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),LIAB_AS_ON_XFER_EFF_DATE)),0) LIAB_AS_ON_XFER_EFF_DATE_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),OCHG_DMD_OS)),0) OCHG_DMD_OS_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),PRE_PROCESS_FEE)),0) PRE_PROCESS_FEE_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),PRIN_DMD_OS)),0) PRIN_DMD_OS_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),REPHASEMENT_PRINCIPAL)),0) REPHASEMENT_PRINCIPAL_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),RESHDL_OVERDUE_INT)),0) RESHDL_OVERDUE_INT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),RESHDL_OVERDUE_PRIN)),0) RESHDL_OVERDUE_PRIN_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),VALUE_OF_ASSET)),0) VALUE_OF_ASSET_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LAACCTMAST WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
,ACCR_PENAL_DMD_OS ACCR_PENAL_DMD_OS_src
,BCHG_DMD_OS BCHG_DMD_OS_src
,CUM_CAPITALIZE_FEES CUM_CAPITALIZE_FEES_src
,EMICAP_DEFERRED_INT EMICAP_DEFERRED_INT_src
,FIXED_PYMT FIXED_PYMT_src
,INT_DMD_OS INT_DMD_OS_src
,LIAB_AS_ON_XFER_EFF_DATE LIAB_AS_ON_XFER_EFF_DATE_src
,OCHG_DMD_OS OCHG_DMD_OS_src
,PRE_PROCESS_FEE PRE_PROCESS_FEE_src
,PRIN_DMD_OS PRIN_DMD_OS_src
,REPHASEMENT_PRINCIPAL REPHASEMENT_PRINCIPAL_src
,RESHDL_OVERDUE_INT RESHDL_OVERDUE_INT_src
,RESHDL_OVERDUE_PRIN RESHDL_OVERDUE_PRIN_src
,VALUE_OF_ASSET VALUE_OF_ASSET_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_LNS_LAACCTMAST WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
,ACCR_PENAL_DMD_OS_src
,BCHG_DMD_OS_src
,CUM_CAPITALIZE_FEES_src
,EMICAP_DEFERRED_INT_src
,FIXED_PYMT_src
,INT_DMD_OS_src
,LIAB_AS_ON_XFER_EFF_DATE_src
,OCHG_DMD_OS_src
,PRE_PROCESS_FEE_src
,PRIN_DMD_OS_src
,REPHASEMENT_PRINCIPAL_src
,RESHDL_OVERDUE_INT_src
,RESHDL_OVERDUE_PRIN_src
,VALUE_OF_ASSET_src
,ACCR_PENAL_DMD_OS_tgt
,BCHG_DMD_OS_tgt
,CUM_CAPITALIZE_FEES_tgt
,EMICAP_DEFERRED_INT_tgt
,FIXED_PYMT_tgt
,INT_DMD_OS_tgt
,LIAB_AS_ON_XFER_EFF_DATE_tgt
,OCHG_DMD_OS_tgt
,PRE_PROCESS_FEE_tgt
,PRIN_DMD_OS_tgt
,REPHASEMENT_PRINCIPAL_tgt
,RESHDL_OVERDUE_INT_tgt
,RESHDL_OVERDUE_PRIN_tgt
,VALUE_OF_ASSET_tgt

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT 
 CAST(COUNT_SRC AS numeric(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS numeric(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(ACCR_PENAL_DMD_OS_src AS numeric(25,5)) ACCR_PENAL_DMD_OS_src
,CAST(BCHG_DMD_OS_src AS numeric(25,5)) BCHG_DMD_OS_src
,CAST(CUM_CAPITALIZE_FEES_src AS numeric(25,5)) CUM_CAPITALIZE_FEES_src
,CAST(EMICAP_DEFERRED_INT_src AS numeric(25,5)) EMICAP_DEFERRED_INT_src
,CAST(FIXED_PYMT_src AS numeric(25,5)) FIXED_PYMT_src
,CAST(INT_DMD_OS_src AS numeric(25,5)) INT_DMD_OS_src
,CAST(LIAB_AS_ON_XFER_EFF_DATE_src AS numeric(25,5)) LIAB_AS_ON_XFER_EFF_DATE_src
,CAST(OCHG_DMD_OS_src AS numeric(25,5)) OCHG_DMD_OS_src
,CAST(PRE_PROCESS_FEE_src AS numeric(25,5)) PRE_PROCESS_FEE_src
,CAST(PRIN_DMD_OS_src AS numeric(25,5)) PRIN_DMD_OS_src
,CAST(REPHASEMENT_PRINCIPAL_src AS numeric(25,5)) REPHASEMENT_PRINCIPAL_src
,CAST(RESHDL_OVERDUE_INT_src AS numeric(25,5)) RESHDL_OVERDUE_INT_src
,CAST(RESHDL_OVERDUE_PRIN_src AS numeric(25,5)) RESHDL_OVERDUE_PRIN_src
,CAST(VALUE_OF_ASSET_src AS numeric(25,5)) VALUE_OF_ASSET_src
,CAST(ACCR_PENAL_DMD_OS_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) ACCR_PENAL_DMD_OS_tgt
,CAST(BCHG_DMD_OS_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) BCHG_DMD_OS_tgt
,CAST(CUM_CAPITALIZE_FEES_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) CUM_CAPITALIZE_FEES_tgt
,CAST(EMICAP_DEFERRED_INT_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) EMICAP_DEFERRED_INT_tgt
,CAST(FIXED_PYMT_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) FIXED_PYMT_tgt
,CAST(INT_DMD_OS_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) INT_DMD_OS_tgt
,CAST(LIAB_AS_ON_XFER_EFF_DATE_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) LIAB_AS_ON_XFER_EFF_DATE_tgt
,CAST(OCHG_DMD_OS_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) OCHG_DMD_OS_tgt
,CAST(PRE_PROCESS_FEE_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) PRE_PROCESS_FEE_tgt
,CAST(PRIN_DMD_OS_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) PRIN_DMD_OS_tgt
,CAST(REPHASEMENT_PRINCIPAL_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) REPHASEMENT_PRINCIPAL_tgt
,CAST(RESHDL_OVERDUE_INT_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) RESHDL_OVERDUE_INT_tgt
,CAST(RESHDL_OVERDUE_PRIN_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) RESHDL_OVERDUE_PRIN_tgt
,CAST(VALUE_OF_ASSET_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) VALUE_OF_ASSET_tgt
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
,ACCR_PENAL_DMD_OS_src
,BCHG_DMD_OS_src
,CUM_CAPITALIZE_FEES_src
,EMICAP_DEFERRED_INT_src
,FIXED_PYMT_src
,INT_DMD_OS_src
,LIAB_AS_ON_XFER_EFF_DATE_src
,OCHG_DMD_OS_src
,PRE_PROCESS_FEE_src
,PRIN_DMD_OS_src
,REPHASEMENT_PRINCIPAL_src
,RESHDL_OVERDUE_INT_src
,RESHDL_OVERDUE_PRIN_src
,VALUE_OF_ASSET_src

 )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
,ACCR_PENAL_DMD_OS_tgt
,BCHG_DMD_OS_tgt
,CUM_CAPITALIZE_FEES_tgt
,EMICAP_DEFERRED_INT_tgt
,FIXED_PYMT_tgt
,INT_DMD_OS_tgt
,LIAB_AS_ON_XFER_EFF_DATE_tgt
,OCHG_DMD_OS_tgt
,PRE_PROCESS_FEE_tgt
,PRIN_DMD_OS_tgt
,REPHASEMENT_PRINCIPAL_tgt
,RESHDL_OVERDUE_INT_tgt
,RESHDL_OVERDUE_PRIN_tgt
,VALUE_OF_ASSET_tgt

 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
